text: Hold there! What's in the packs? Goods going out of the town pay their toll.
speaker: p259

text: A penny a horse-load. It keeps the walls standing.
speaker: p259

text: Thank you kindly. On you go, and God speed.
speaker: p259

text: Oh, go on, then. Just this once. But don't let me see you trying it again.
speaker: p259

text: No toll, no passage. Off with you.
speaker: p259
